name: Coffee Pub Minstrel
tagline: A GM soundboard: music, ambience and cues in one window.
description: A GM-only live console for soundtrack, ambience and one-shot effects, with reusable sound scenes, favorites, cues with music ducking, and automation rules on top of standard Foundry playlists.
pitch: Run your game's soundtrack from one window instead of hunting through the playlist sidebar mid-scene.

features.title: Sound scenes
features.text: Combine a music track, looping ambience and periodic sound effects, then start the whole scene with one click.

features.title: Live console
features.text: Favorites, now-playing and transport controls without opening the playlist sidebar.

features.title: Cues
features.text: One-shot effects fired by hand, which can duck the music underneath.

features.title: Automation
features.text: Rules start or stop a scene on combat start, round change, entering a new map, or time of day.

features.title: Menubar transport
features.text: Stop music, environment, one-shots or everything without opening the window.

features.title: Standard playlists
features.text: Plays ordinary Foundry playlist sounds; nothing imported or converted.

steps: Open Minstrel from the music note button in the Foundry toolbar (GM only), and play a track in Playlists to confirm sound works.
Mark two or three tracks as favorites so they appear on the Dashboard.
In Sound Scenes, create a scene with a music layer and an environment layer and start it.
needs: At least one playlist with sounds
Game master only; players hear audio but see no interface
